zh.summary: 减少桌面打扰，改进设置响应和插件安装后的恢复体验。
highlights: 关闭窗口转入托盘时仅首次提醒；重启、更新和移动便携目录后不再重复弹出提示。
减少读取本地版本列表时的额外进程启动，让设置操作更轻快。
插件热挂载从实际安装目录解析入口，减少安装后错误提示找不到插件的情况。
插件激活失败后尝试清理部分挂载，避免残留功能；需要重启时继续明确提示。
更新权限界面适配，保留新版上游已经提供的本地化界面。
upgradeNotes: 本版仍内置已验证的 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。后续候选内核通过独立验收后进入候选通道，用户可自行选择。

en.summary: Reduce desktop interruptions and improve settings responsiveness and recovery after plugin installation.
highlights: Show the close-to-tray explanation only once, preserving this choice across restarts, updates and folder moves.
Avoid an extra process when reading local version catalogs for more responsive settings.
Resolve hot-mounted plugin entries from their installed profile to avoid misleading missing-plugin errors.
Attempt cleanup after partial plugin activation failures while retaining explicit restart guidance.
Update permission UI compatibility to preserve localization already provided by newer upstream components.
upgradeNotes: This release still bundles qualified DSH 0.1.5-rc.2. Candidate cores become selectable through the candidate channel after separate qualification.
